favourite.heading: Why Sacramento State can pull away
bullets: Playing at Sacramento State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Sacramento State by 0.4 points: field position (+0.4 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Massachusetts can keep it close
bullets: Massachusetts is the better football team by 0.6 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 55% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-0.6 pts).
The outcome range is 15.1 points wide at one sigma — p10 -19.2 to p90 +24.8 for Sacramento State, so a projection of +3.8 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 3%.

The market disagrees by 8.3 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
